title: A Day of the Sun
summary: This story shows children the importance of nature and life through the Sun's journey during the day.

texts: Children from Wini Bruma Kindergarten, East Timor
Patrocino, Joel, Noel, Bernadete, Jenildo, Narlia, Monica Cessy, Berta Pinto, Teodoru, Vidal, Lindalva, Odilton
I start the day by rising over the sea.
I stand above the trees, beyond the sea.
Thanks to me, the seeds grow.
They grow and sometimes become flowers.
And sometimes they grow into trees.
Thus, there are many trees and flowers because of me.
I can also rise above mountains.
I shine on parks where people are.
Fish in the water also need me.
At the end of the day, I return to the sea, goodbye.

postQuestions.question: How does the Sun help nature and children throughout the day?

missions.title: Observe the Sun's Day
missions.description: Think about the Sun's journey during the day. Write or draw your own experience or imagination about the Sun, nature, and children.

vocabulary.definition: Small parts of plants that grow into new plants.
Parts of plants that bloom and grow colorful.
Large plants that grow from seeds and provide shade and oxygen.
Areas where people can relax and enjoy nature.
